_doc: Today's Chicago River, Branches and canal water polygons, for the Today window's 1871 registration (tools/today_registration.mjs, renderers/web/js/today-register.js). Each polygon is the City of Chicago's own (data/sources/chicago_waterways_2026.json), features named CHICAGO RIVER, NORTH BRANCH CHICAGO RIVER or SOUTH BRANCH CHICAGO RIVER inside the 1871 scene's box, outer ring first then any holes, longitude then latitude as the City publishes them, rounded to 1e-6 degree and thinned to within about 0.25 m. A MODERN control, read only by the registration tool and its test: nothing in a period layer is placed from it, and it is not published to the site.
